programme.title: Bioskop Asia: Snake Fist
programme.desc: Bioskop Asia: Snake Fist

programme.title: Mega Bollywood: Dil
programme.desc: Seorang pria berpura-pura menjadi industrialis kaya untuk meningkatkan peluang putranya menikah dengan orang kaya, namun rencananya menjadi bumerang baginya.

programme.title: Jhanak
programme.desc: Setelah kematian ibunya, Jhanak terpaksa menikahi tunangan sepupunya Arshi, Aniruddh, untuk melarikan diri dari penguntitnya, Tejas. Meskipun Aniruddh dan Arshi telah bersama selama tujuh tahun, Jhanak memasuki kehidupan mereka dalam keadaan yang menyedihkan dan mulai bekerja sebagai pembantu di rumah tangga Bose. Sementara beberapa anggota keluarga memperlakukannya dengan baik, yang lain terus-menerus menghina dan meremehkannya.

programme.title: Hati ke Hati Bersama Mamah Dedeh

programme.title: Sayali
programme.desc: Udne Ki Aasha tells the story of Sachin and Sailee, a middle-class couple, as they navigate the complexities of their relationship. The story centers on Sailee’s struggles as she faces resistance from her husband and her efforts to inspire change not only for their own growth but also for the well-being of their entire family.

programme.title: Aini: Malaikat Tak Bersayap
programme.desc: Aini, seorang gadis yang durhaka kepada ibunya. Perubahan sikap Aini terjadi setelah kehidupan dan pergaulannya yang mewah, berubah 180 derajat. Aini selalu mengacuhkan segala nasihat ibunya dan menjerumuskan diri ke dalam kemaksiatan.

programme.title: Jaane Anjaane
programme.desc: A smart journalist Reet and hot-headed Raghav enter an arranged marriage through the 'Aata Sata' custom to secure their siblings' happiness. Their relationship of convenience faces unexpected turns.

programme.title: Teri Meri Doriyaann
programme.desc: The fate of the three Brar cousins Angad, Garry and Veer are linked with the three Monga sisters Sahiba, Seerat and Keerat. Sahiba is the hardworking and independent second daughter of the Monga family. She is an artist and earns money for her family by selling her art. Seerat, the eldest Monga sister, is pampered by her mother, Santosh, for her beauty. Santosh dreams of getting Seerat married to a rich man. As fate would have it, Angad falls in love with Seerat. However, Seerat is manipulated by Garry and his fake love. On Seerat and Angad's wedding day, Seerat runs away with Garry.

programme.title: Sinema Pagi: Pendekar Jagat Kelana
programme.desc: Jagat Kelana, seorang pemuda yang berguru dengan Ki Fajar Sakti yang kemudian menjadi pendekar, turun gunung setelah bertahun-tahun. Ia berniat balas dendam dengan gerombolan Satri Gandar yang membunuh orangtuanya serta saat ia tahu gerombolan itu mengganggu penduduk dan menculik Gantini, pacarnya, ia bertindak dan akhirnya berhasil menghancurkan gerombolan itu.

programme.title: Kampung Keramat
programme.desc: After an accident leaves Maya paralyzed and haunted, her family seeks a shaman’s cure in a remote village. The ritual unleashes terror, putting all their lives in danger.

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: At a Hong Kong shopping center, Buck Yuen's (Jackie Chan's) intuition warns him. He saves a robbery's loot and gets on television, ends up in Istanbul via South Korea, and accidentally becomes a spy. Fortunately, he knows Kung Fu.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Taoist Priest isn't happy when his Buddhist Priest colleague moves in next door. They are subject to feuds and duels, but soon must overcome their problems when a vampire breaks loose from his coffin and wreaks havoc to the countryside.

programme.title: 36 Secrets Of Courtship
programme.desc: Three lotharios vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School, an extremely non-monastic institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Action superstar Chow Yun-Fat portrays real-life gangster Chen Daqi as he rises to the upper echelons of power, finding himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei has post-traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, he becomes the firm's VR fighter.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: This refreshing musical comedy tempers its fizzy charm with just enough tartness to insure its charming buoyancy. This light look at teenage life even won starlet Chou Hsiu-lan a Hong Kong Film Awards nomination for Best Newcomer.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: JJ/Shu Qi and PI Lam (Dong jing gong lüe (2000)) steal 2 stolen USD100 plates in HK. Lam loses them - no US reward. Lam and his 3 cute angels try to get them again in Seoul as does JJ. Lots of fighting.

programme.title: Love In A Fallen City
programme.desc: A cynical playboy pursues an introverted divorcee in the decadence of Hong Kong on the eve of the 1941 Japanese invasion.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Small-time conman and mechanic Lolanto finds himself in trouble when he cheats gangster Yu Yan Tat out of his high-end sports car on a three-day loan, where new sparkplugs would have sufficed.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: A woman is raped and murdered during World War 2. Forty years later she returns to haunt her persecutors from the Tao Tao Mansion. A professor and his family move into the house, only to have the spirits take their son.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission. But his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: How To Pick Girls Up!
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: As a man leaves his wife and daughter, a series of brief conversations, observed gestures, chance encounters and impulsive acts, tell the story of the relationships that flounder and thrive in the wake of this decision.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Never take your mistress on an annual guys' getaway, especially one devoted to hunting - a violent lesson for three wealthy married men.

programme.title: Royal Tramp 2
programme.desc: Wei the jester, turned undercover spy, turned high ranking official in the Chinese imperial court, tries his best to deal with warring factions and deadly martial artists all vying for power.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: Brilliant director Sun Chung and the majestic Ti Lung reunite for a thriller about an aging fighter who relives his violent past mistakes through a streetwise kid.

programme.title: Get In The Dark
programme.desc: Miss Qiao had died in vain and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge and a series of horrible events begins to happen.

programme.title: The Mask Of Shura Of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: The Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing quits the force after getting demoted to traffic duties, while his partner is assigned a mission involving foreign terrorists threatening to bomb a school in Hong Kong, so Sing decides to help by going undercover at the same school.

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: An evil warlord takes in 2 students (Wind And Cloud) in an effort to become invincible so he can take over the world.

programme.title: Out Of The Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. Freaked out by the haunting, the security guards invite ghostbuster Leo and his assistant to help.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: When a young man ignores a feng shui master's warning and decides to marry before turning 30, a series of mishaps begins to curse his life.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: Hero Wah goes to study under Master Pride. When he returns to his parents, he learns that they have been murdered by a band of evil Westerners. After impregnating his wife Jade, he ventures to New York in search of his parents' killers.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter-the sole witness-mysteriously disappears.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: Agent Jon contemplates leaving the force until he learns his brother is working as a mercenary for a former colleague who betrayed their team.

programme.title: Confession Of Pain
programme.desc: A detective helps a friend investigate the mysterious death of his father-in-law.

programme.title: Whisper Of Silent Body
programme.desc: Forensic pathologist Qin works with his assistant and the police captain to resolve the backlog of cases.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Fai, once a world champion in boxing, escapes to Macau from the loan sharks and unexpectedly encounters Qi, a young chap who is determined to win a boxing match.

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: The Flying Mr. B

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: The story revolves around a dutiful yet indifferent fireman, who can march into disaster and risk his lives by saving others, yet would he have the equivalent courage to tackle his personal issues?

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter who decides to life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. He is implicated in the fights and conspiracies. When his friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must save his friend.

programme.title: Interview with the Vampire
programme.desc: Berlatar di San Fransisco pada akhir abad ke-20, film ini berkisah tentang seorang vampir berusia 200 tahun yang menceritakan kisah hidupnya nan penuh cinta, kesedihan dan teror pada seorang reporter muda.

programme.title: Lady in the Water
programme.desc: Cleveland Heep, seorang pengawas gedung apartemen, menyelamatkan seseorang yang ia kira adalah seorang wanita muda dari kolam renang yang ia rawat. Ketika ia mengetahui bahwa wanita itu sebenarnya adalah tokoh dari dongeng pengantar tidur yang sedang berusaha kembali ke rumahnya, ia bekerja sama dengan para penghuninya untuk melindungi teman barunya itu dari makhluk-makhluk yang bertekad untuk menahannya di dunia kita.

programme.title: Sacrifice
programme.desc: An undercover cop inadvertently gets involved in a dangerous heroin ring when a young defector of the drug trade leaves his five year-old sister in his care.

programme.title: Alone We Fight
programme.desc: Facing mounting odds, a small but determined band of American soldiers venture into dangerous enemy territory on a mission to stop an advancing German unit from breaking through the Allied line.

programme.title: Game Of Death
programme.desc: A martial arts movie star must fake his death to find the people who are trying to kill him.

programme.title: Look Away
programme.desc: Maria, an alienated high-school student, has her life turned upside down when she switches places with her sinister mirror image.

programme.title: Darkness Of Man
programme.desc: Interpol operative Russell Hatch witnesses the death of an informant when a seemingly routine raid goes wrong. Years later, he finds himself protecting the informant's son from a group of merciless gangs involved in an all-out turf war.

programme.title: Candy Land
programme.desc: A seemingly naive and devout young woman navigates her way into the underground world of truck stop sex workers a.k.a. lot lizards.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Clown Motel
programme.desc: When Alma returns home to help her family get their Native American heritage recognized, all she finds is the World-Famous Clown Motel that has been erected on their land.

programme.title: Time Is Up
programme.desc: Vivien, a student who postpones happiness for the future, meets Roy, a troubled young man. But when an accident occurs and changes their lives, their focus shifts to being happy in the present.

programme.title: Another Mother's Son
programme.desc: Lou lives on the Nazi-occupied Island of Jersey during World War 2. She accepts to hide a young Russian POW at her house at the risk of being imprisoned herself and takes care of him as if he was her own son.

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: A young woman must save herself and her friends from an ancient evil that stalks its victims through the real-life phenomenon of sleep paralysis.

programme.title: Winter War
programme.desc: In 1939, two Finnish brothers are conscripted in the army to fight in the war between Finland and the Soviet Union.

programme.title: The Super
programme.desc: A man becomes the superintendent of a large New York City apartment building where people mysteriously go missing.

programme.title: Code Name: Geronimo
programme.desc: A group of Navy SEALs comes to learn the identity of their target: Osama bin Laden.

programme.title: The Last Son
programme.desc: An outlaw attempts to end his evil family line.

programme.title: Play Dead
programme.desc: Chloe fakes her own death to steal evidence from a morgue. The Coroner uses the morgue as a front for a sick and twisted business. Then, Chloe learns more about the dead than she bargains for.

programme.title: The Curse Of Sleeping Beauty
programme.desc: A man inherits an ancestral mansion and an ancient curse stemming back to the Crusades.

programme.title: Wicked Games
programme.desc: When Harley joins her new boyfriend for a long Halloween weekend at his country estate, they're invaded by a band of masked freaks and forced to play a Wicked Game. To the intruders' unpleasant surprise, Harley's hard-boiled history has endowed her with a bag of tricks which give the game a surprise ending.

programme.title: The Canyons
programme.desc: When Christian, an LA trust-fund kid with casual ties to Hollywood, learns of a secret affair between Tara and Ryan, he spirals out of control, and his cruel mind games escalate into an act of bloody violence.

programme.title: Armed Response
programme.desc: A remote facility, built as a prison with a secret super lie detector, is compromised and the five guarding it are possibly dead. An armed team of six investigates what's wrong.

programme.title: Hunting Games
programme.desc: When a group of ex-military members is hired to retrieve a lost bag of stolen money, their mission becomes more difficult after a lone hunter finds the bag first.

programme.title: Murder Syndicate
programme.desc: When the matriarch of a family of assassins falls ill, her three children and younger boyfriend fight among themselves to take over her empire.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: Set during World War 2, a squad of American Army soldiers are sent on a mission behind lines to locate their missing commanding officer.

programme.title: Damon's Revenge

programme.title: Ustadz On The Road
programme.desc: Program Religi Yang Dipandu Oleh Seorang Host Dan Ustadz Yang Akan Memberikan Kajian Islami Dengan Treatment On The Road Disertai Dengan Study Kasus. programme.title: Marsupilami
programme.desc: Hector Ikut Dengan Tantenya, Diane, Untuk Menghabiskan Satu Tahun Di Hutan Agar Dia Dapat Mempelajari Flora Dan Fauna. Sebagai Seorang Anak Laki-Laki Yang Senang Akan Petualangan, Ia Berteman Baik Dengan Marsupilami Yang Legendaris. Hector Memiliki Keluarga Baru Yang Menyenangkan Dengan Hidup Di Antara Hewan - Hewan Tersebut. Suatu Hari, Kehidupan Barunya Yang Menyenangkan Di Hutan Tiba-Tiba Terancam Dengan Kedatangan Felicia Devort, Seorang Industrialis Megalomaniak Yang Ingin Merusak Hutan Untuk Membangun Kota Devort Di Lokasi Hutan Itu.

programme.title: Metal Cardbot
programme.desc: Dahulu Kala, Terdapat Sebuah Planet Bernama Machina Dimana Metal Cardbots Tinggal. Suatu Ketika, Planet Ini Tiba-Tiba Meledak Dan Memaksa Semua Penghuninya Untuk Hidup Di Bumi. Agar Tidak Menarik Perhatian Makhluk Bumi, Cardbots Menyamar Sebagai Kendaraan Sehari-Hari. Hingga Suatu Hari, Seorang Anak Sekolah Dasar Yang Bernama Jun Secara Tidak Sengaja Menemukan Metal Breath, Dengan Metal Breath Tersebut Dia Bisa Menangkap Dan Menyalakan Cardbots Dengan Kemampuan Yang Berbeda.

programme.title: Bread Barbershop
programme.desc: Bread, Seorang Tukang Cukur Jenius, Memecahkan Masalah Penampilan Dengan Keterampilan Memotong Rambutnya Yang Briliant. Sekarang Dia Hadir Untuk Memecahkan Masalah Para Bintang Di Bakery Town. Bertentangan Dengan Penampilan Mereka Yang Glamor Dan Bersinar, Para Selebriti Ini Menjalani Hari Yang Sangat Suram. Bread Dan Keluarganya Siap Membantu Para Selebriti Untuk Menemukan Lagi Kebahagiaan Mereka.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Rainbow Ruby Adalah Kisah Tentang Seorang Gadis Kecil Yang Gagah Dan Banyak Akal Yang Secara Ajaib Diangkut Ke Rainbow 'Village, Tanah Aneh Yang Dihuni Oleh Mainannya, Dan Berubah Menjadi Pekerjaan Yang Berbeda Untuk Membantu Mencegah Bencana . Serial Ini Mengambil Fantasi Masa Kecil Boneka Menjadi Hidup, Dan Bercampur Dalam Pahlawan Wanita Aspiratif Yang Membuktikan Bahwa Anda Bisa Menjadi Apa Pun Yang Anda Inginkan.

programme.title: Nailoong Vs Bombloong
programme.desc: Nailoong Dan Seven Menjalani Kehidupan Damai Hingga Kedatangan Bombloong, Seekor Naga Jahat Yang Ingin Menjadi Yang Terkuat Dan Menimbulkan Kekacauan Di Desa. Mereka Pun Berusaha Sekuat Tenaga Untuk Menghentikan Kejahatan Bombloong.

programme.title: We Bare Bears Iii
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Kehidupan Tiga Saudara Beruang: Grizzly, Panda, Dan Ice Bear. Mereka Berusaha Keras Untuk Berintegrasi Dengan Masyarakat Manusia Di San Francisco Bay Area, Seperti Mencari Makan, Berteman, Atau Menjadi Populer Di Internet

programme.title: Boboiboy
programme.desc: Sebuah Program Animasi Yang Mengisahkan Boboiboy Dan Teman-Temannya Yakni Gopal, Ying, Dan Yaya Yang Masing-Masing Memiliki Kekuatan Super. Dengan Kekuatan Yang Dimiliki Mereka Mencegah Adu Du Mencuri Biji Kakao Tok Aba Yang Digunakan Sebagai Sumber Energi. Selain Itu, Boboiboy Dan Teman-Temannya Menjadi Pahlawan Super Dalam Menumpas Kejahatan Dan Menjaga Kedamaian Bumi.

programme.title: Blox Buster
programme.desc: Blox Buster Adalah Program Entertainment Yang Menghadirkan Keseruan Bermain Di Dunia Roblox, Platform Game Populer Dengan Jutaan Kreasi Dari Komunitas Global, Penonton Diajak Menjelajahi Berbagai Dunia Virtual Yang Penuh Warna, Menantang, Sekaligus Menyenangkan. Tidak Hanya Sekadar Bermain, Main Bareng Blox Juga Menyuguhkan Pengalaman Unik Dari Para Gamers Yang Ikut Serta, Mulai Dari Review Game, Tips Seru, Hingga Momen-Momen Kejutan Yang Terjadi Saat Bermain.

programme.title: Tawa Satwa
programme.desc: Program Yang Menampilkan Kompilasi Video Lucu Hewan Yang Viral Di Media Sosial Dan Di-React Secara Kekinian Oleh Voice Over Talent Dengan Karakter Beragam Yang Akan Menambah Kelucuan.

programme.title: Ejen Ali
programme.desc: Serial Animasi Dengan Tokoh Utaman Bernama Ali Yang Tidak Sengaja Menjadi Agen Meta Advance Tactical Agency (Mata) Kemudian Dilatih Untuk Menjadi Agen Di Akademi Mata. Ali Membuktikan Diri Bahwa Ia Mampu Menjadi Agen Mata Dan Mengalahkan Musuh Bersama Alicia Dan Paman Bakar.

programme.title: Super Wings
programme.desc: Pengantaran Paket Oleh Jett Yang Akan Ditemani Oleh Super Wings Lainnya Yang Juga Bisa Berubah Menjadi Robot Untuk Memudahkan Mereka Dalam Mengantarkan Paket Untuk Anak-Anak Di Seluruh Dunia Mulai Dari Pengantaran Yang Ringan Sampai Pengantaran Yang Sangat Berat.

programme.title: The Tom & Jerry

Diam-diam,Bimo menyimpan rahasia besar tanpa diketahui keluarganya.
